info.name: JAPS POS - Sales Rep App API v1
info.description: Native Sales Representative app. Same rules as the /sale PWA. Run **0. Setup & Auth > Login** first; the token is saved to `{{token}}` automatically. Change `{{base_url}}` to the client's server.

variable.description: Server root chosen by the user in the app (no trailing slash, no /api).
Set automatically by the Login request.

request.description: Public. Call when the user enters / changes the server URL. A valid JAPS POS server answers `success: true` and `data.api = "japspos-mobile"`.
Sales rep username + password. Admin and users without sales-order/sell permission get 403.
Current account, permissions and business settings.
Revokes the token used for this request.
Revokes every token of this account for this app.
Stats (today / month), recent orders, new and top products for the current location.
Profile + permitted locations + current location.
Permitted business locations and the current (default) one.
Saved per device (token).
Clears server catalog cache; returns synced_at.
No section = report only (orders list empty).

query.description: orders | invoices | payments | visits | day | quotes | credit

request.description: Paginated (20). meta = pagination.

query.description: sale (not invoiced) | invoiced | estimate | orders | payments | credit

request.description: status without section searches all dates.
Locations, customer, saved cart, options.

order_mode: new_order | estimate | back_order. payment_type: cash | due. unit_price = price of the selected unit (only used when user has edit_order_price permission, otherwise catalog price is used).

  "contact_id": "{{contact_id}}",
  "location_id": 1,

  "products": [
    {
      "product_id": "{{product_id}}",
      "variation_id": "{{variation_id}}",
      "quantity": 2,
      "unit_price": 20.99,
      "sub_unit_id": 1
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Lines, grouped items, amounts, payments (invoice snapshot after conversion).
403 if invoiced or no so.update / so.update_own.
Send transaction_sell_lines_id for existing lines; omitted lines are removed.
Needs so.delete or so.delete_own. Estimates cannot be deleted from the app.
text/html US-Letter invoice for a WebView / print.
PDF download.
One saved cart per customer (newest first in the app).
Upserts the saved cart for the customer.

query.description: customer whose saved cart is removed

request.description: saved id from Saved carts (e.g. so6ac93f105f9e04.99057373).
Locations, default location, category tree.
Stock + units per variation.
Category -> sub_categories.
Last 40 orders/invoices, one row per variation.
Last 20 lines of a variation for a customer.

query.description: name / mobile / email / business / account no

request.description: Paginated (20). Needs customer.view / customer.view_own.
Max 40 active customers.
Customer groups. Needs customer.create.
allow_customer_app=1 also enables Customer-app login (password = customer_app_password or mobile).

request.description: Details, aging, open invoices, history.
Final sell invoice or sales order of this customer.
Active payment methods of current location + open invoices.
Pays oldest due invoices first (payContact). pay_mode=credit records a reverse/credit payment. signature = PNG data URL (optional).
Own expenses (or all with all_expense.access). Paginated (20).
Locations, categories, sub categories, payment methods per location.
document: pdf, csv, zip, doc, docx, jpeg, jpg, png (max 5 MB).
Own sales orders sorted from the current POS location.
latitude/longitude required when the location has a geofence.
Paginated (20).
Locations + statuses + can_create.
Stock-managed products with purchase price.
Needs stock_transfer.create. unit_price defaults to purchase price.
